summary: LinuxGSM is a command-line utility designed to deploy and manage dedicated game servers on Linux systems. It automates common administrative tasks across a large catalog of supported multiplayer titles.
goodFor: Self-hosters and system administrators who prefer managing game servers via the terminal and shell scripts rather than using heavy web-based control panels.
watchOut: Relying entirely on a command-line interface means there is no graphical dashboard out of the box, which might increase the learning curve for less technical users.
deployNotes: Because it runs as a shell-based tool, it typically requires direct access to the host operating system with appropriate user permissions and persistent storage for game files and configurations.
